proposed_capability: Use typed per-installation preferences and a current catalog chooser through the existing BetterInstincts Play and Settings surfaces.
operator_correction: BetterInstincts owns launch and remembered household choice. Give the player a configurable nonzero idle window, optional cheats denial and production/developer route choice.
repository_situation: Managed Play currently uses mode flags; installation settings and native save catalog already exist but the default shortcut does not join them.

competing_theses.thesis: Separate browser server and settings store
competing_theses.evidence: Existing local Settings UI and store already handle preference changes.

competing_theses.thesis: Infer household and save from disk
competing_theses.evidence: The authoritative in-game catalog binds current process, slot, household and observed chronology.

competing_theses.thesis: Extend existing Settings and Play owners
competing_theses.evidence: They already expose private revisions, current catalog and protected save routing without a parallel launcher.

player_save_control_impact: Persist player choices locally and apply additional denial gates. Existing protected slots, save identity, exact-build binding, playback proof and window leases remain required.
expected_outcome: Double-click Play consumes local preferences, asks for verified human choice as necessary, and routes through guarded launch; no silent retarget or cheat acceptance.
negative_tests: Zero and below-floor idle windows rejected
Protected save and stale catalog hold
Wrong family in newest production save does not retarget or silently use an older save
Disabled cheats never enter the guarded host cheat sender
Unknown native selection capability holds instead of issuing a guess
Legacy profile and explicit Play flags still load
rollback_path: Revert code and clear its new launch option overrides using the settings UI before rolling back. Do not delete installation preferences, game files or saves.
unresolved_unknowns: Live Windows catalog, calibrated map and exact-build native adapters require independent observation.
next_gate: Run isolated profile/routing/UI tests and exact-build Windows adapter acceptance separately.
